origin.description: Nested Wald and tau-score rank tests for fits that share a tau.
origin.details: Nested Wald and tau-score rank tests for fits that share a tau.
origin.value: anova of y~x1+x2, y~x1, and y~1 at tau 0.5, plus the rank test of the two larger fits
origin.example:
full <- rq(y ~ x1 + x2, data=df, tau=0.5)
slope <- rq(y ~ x1, data=df, tau=0.5)
intercept <- rq(y ~ 1, data=df, tau=0.5)
a <- anova(full, slope, intercept, se="nid")
b <- anova(full, slope, test="rank", score="tau")
c(unlist(a$table), unlist(b$table))

translation.description: Nested Wald and tau-score rank tests for fits that share a tau.
translation.details: Nested Wald and tau-score rank tests for fits that share a tau.
translation.value: anova of y~x1+x2, y~x1, and y~1 at tau 0.5, plus the rank test of the two larger fits
translation.example:
from quantreg import rq, anova_rqlist, print_anova_rq
full = rq("y ~ x1 + x2", tau=0.5, data=data)
slope = rq("y ~ x1", tau=0.5, data=data)
intercept = rq("y ~ 1", tau=0.5, data=data)
a = print_anova_rq(anova_rqlist([full, slope, intercept], test="Wald", se="nid"))
b = print_anova_rq(anova_rqlist([full, slope], test="rank"))
return np.concatenate([a, b])
